notes: Not now, Anis. You've got this, and I've got you.
Every minute you focus, I'm a little more proud of you.
Instagram can wait. Your dreams can't.
Put the phone down and go be brilliant, my love.
I believe in you more than you'll ever know.
One page at a time. I'm right here cheering for you.
You're working so hard, and I see it. Keep going.
Close this, take a deep breath, and finish strong.
The best version of you is being built right now.
Focus now, and I'll be waiting with a hug later.
You promised yourself this time. I'm holding you to it, gently.
Nothing on that feed is as interesting as your future.
Hey you. Back to work, handsome.
Small steps every day. That's how you get everywhere.
I'm so lucky to love someone this determined.
Tired? That's okay. Just a little more, then rest.

Stay with it, Anis. The timer's on your side.

Proud of you today, tomorrow, and always.
